newsitem.title: FRANCE: Most of CADES dlr FRN sold in Europe, Asia - CADES.
newsitem.headline: Most of CADES dlr FRN sold in Europe, Asia - CADES.

text.p: French welfare debt repayment fund CADES said on Thursday the majority of its $2 billion five-year floating rate note issue, which it launched on Tuesday, went to financial institutions in Europe and Asia.

CADES said in a statement "The syndicate in charge of the transaction reported total sales of 40 percent in Asia, 10 percent in the United States, 40 percent in Europe and 10 percent in the Middle East."
"In terms of investor type, central banks and bank treasuries accounted for 20 percent each of the total placement, the remainder being institutional funds," CADES said.
